svg.title: LoRA-JIT: Structural weight paging for consumer GPUs.
svg.desc: LoRA-JIT — Structural weight paging for consumer GPUs. Experiments in local adapter routing, just-in-time model state, and the telemetry needed to know when the system is actually winning. Tags: Python, Local AI, GPU Systems.
